name: The Streets Below
text:
If both positions are the same:
• Each character gets +1 ATK.
If the positions are different:
• Reduce the amount of damage each character takes from each attack by 1.
• Threat cannot be removed from the main scheme.

name: Atop the Tenshu
text:
If both positions are the same:
• Each character gets +1 ATK.
If the positions are different:
• Reduce the amount of damage each character takes from each attack by 1.
• Threat cannot be removed from the main scheme.

name: The Streets Below
text: First Player Action: Resolve one of the effects below, then flip this card: • Place 3 threat on the main scheme and stun your identity. • Spend [physical][physical] resources. • Spend 1 resource of any type and exhaust an [[Aerial]] character you control.

name: Atop the Tenshu
text: First Player Action: Resolve one of the effects below, then flip this card: • Deal 3 damage to your identity. • Spend [energy][energy] resources. • Discard an ally or upgrade you control.

name: Black Tarantula
text: Guard. When Revealed: Change the villain's position if it has not changed this phase. If the villain's position is Atop the Tenshu, Black Tarantula attacks you; otherwise, give the villain and Black Tarantula each a tough status card.

flavor: Under Shadowland, the Hand rules the streets.
name: Strategic Positioning
text:
While the villain's position is The Streets Below, this scheme gains 1 acceleration icon ([acceleration]).
While the villain's position is Atop the Tenshu, this scheme gains 1 hazard icon ([hazard]).

name: Chaos in Hell's Kitchen
text:
When Revealed: Change the villain's position if it has not changed this phase. If the villain's position is Atop the Tenshu, place 2 threat on the main scheme; otherwise, take 2 damage.
[star] Boost: Resolve this card's "When Revealed" ability.

name: Moonlit Silhouette
text: When Revealed (Alter-Ego): Change the villain's position if it has not changed this phase. You are confused. When Revealed (Hero): If the villain's position is Atop the Tenshu, the villain schemes; otherwise, the villain attacks you.

name: Archpriestess
text: [star] Forced Response: After Archpriestess attacks you, give a minion a tough status card. If no tough status card was placed this way, discard the top 3 cards of the encounter deck, then deal 1 minion discarded this way to yourself as a facedown encounter card.

flavor: "Hell's Kitchen is now under the protection of the Hand!"
name: Daredevil
text: Forced Response: After you or an ally you control attacks Daredevil, choose: Either discard 1 random card from your hand, or Daredevil attacks you. (Limit once per round per player.)

flavor: "The Hand guides me, and death follows."
name: Elektra
text: [star] Forced Interrupt: When Elektra attacks you, discard the top card of your deck. If that card's printed cost is an odd number, Elektra gets +1 ATK for this attack; otherwise, this attack gains overkill and piercing.

flavor: "I've died and been born again. There is nothing I fear."
name: Gorgon
text: [star] Forced Interrupt: When Gorgon attacks you, choose: • Spend a [physical] resource. • Stun your identity. • Take 2 indirect damage.

flavor: "I plan to take my time with you."
name: Lady Bullseye
text: [star] Forced Response: After Lady Bullseye attacks you, if that attack was undefended, take 1 indirect damage; otherwise, place 1 threat on the main scheme.

flavor: "Civilization will fall into chaos and darkness, and we who walk the left-hand path will kneel before the Beast!"
name: White Tiger
text: [star] Forced Response: After White Tiger attacks you, she attacks you again with +1 ATK. (Limit once per round per player.)

name: Art of the Kill
text: Linked (Elektra, Lady Bullseye, or White Tiger). Attach to your identity. Forced Interrupt: When an enemy attacks you, it gets +1 ATK for that attack. If that attack defeats a character, place 1 threat on the main scheme. Alter-Ego Action: Spend [energy] [mental] [physical] resources → discard this card.

name: Krahllak's Blessing
text: Linked (Archpriestess, Daredevil, or Gorgon). Attach to the villain. Forced Interrupt: When attached villain would take any amount of damage from a character, reduce that amount by 3. Attached villain attacks that character. Discard this card.

name: Darkness Within
text:
Linked (Archpriestess, Gorgon, or Lady Bullseye). When Revealed: Change to hero form. The villain attacks you.
[star] Boost: If this activation is an attack, it gains overkill.

name: Embraced by Darkness
text:
Linked (Daredevil, Elektra, or White Tiger). When Revealed: The villain schemes. If 2 or less threat was placed on the main scheme this way, discard the top 3 cards of the encounter deck.
[star] Boost: If this activation is an attack, place 2 threat on the main scheme.

name: Black Mountain
text:
Guard. While Black Mountain is engaged with you, each other [[Ninja]] minion engaged with you cannot be attacked.
[star] Boost: If an ally is defending against this attack, reveal this minion.

name: Bo Staff Ninja
text: Teamwork ([[Ninja]]). Toughness. When Defeated: The defeating player discards the top 2 cards of the encounter deck and reveals the first minion with the teamwork keyword discarded this way.

name: Katana Ninja
text: Guard. Teamwork ([[Ninja]]). When Defeated: The defeating player discards the top 2 cards of the encounter deck and reveals the first minion with the teamwork keyword discarded this way.

name: Dancing Shadows
text:
Each [[Ninja]] minion gets +1 hit point. Threat cannot be removed from this scheme while at least 1 [[Ninja]] minion is in play.
[star] Boost: Reveal this card.

name: Countless Numbers
text:
Surge. When Revealed: Shuffle each [[Ninja]] minion in the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck.
[star] Boost: Resolve this card's "When Revealed" ability.

name: Shifting Corridors
text: Stalwart. [star] Forced Interrupt: When Shifting Corridors would activate against you, instead remove 1 passage counter from here and reveal the top card of the trap deck. If the last passage counter is removed from here, the players lose the game.

name: Into the Labyrinth
text: When Revealed: Place 10[per_hero] passage counters on Shifting Corridors (7[per_hero] instead in expert mode). Forced Interrupt: When Shifting Corridors would take any amount of damage, remove that much threat from here instead. Forced Interrupt: When the last threat is removed from this scheme, advance to stage 2A (the players win by advancing).

name: Chamber of Vile Secrets
text: When Revealed: In expert mode, the villain activates against each player. Forced Response: After you or an ally you control thwarts this scheme, reveal the top card of the trap deck. (Limit once per round per player.) If this stage is completed, the players lose the game.

name: Lord Deathstrike
text:
Patrol. When Revealed: If Shifting Corridors is in play, shuffle the top 2 cards of the encounter deck into the trap deck; otherwise, reveal the top card of the trap deck.
[star] Boost: Put this minion into play engaged with you.

name: Dead End
text: Assault. (Basic thwarts against this scheme use ATK instead of THW.) When Revealed: If Shifting Corridors is in play, remove 1 passage counter from it; otherwise, place 1[per_hero] threat here.

name: No Time to Think!
text:
Peril. (While you are resolving this card, other players cannot help you.) When Revealed: The villain activates against you.
[star] Boost: If this activation is an attack, this card gains [boost][boost] and this attack gains overkill.

name: Sudden Shift
text:
When Revealed: Shuffle the trap discard pile and the top 3 cards of the encounter deck into the trap deck. Reveal the top card of the trap deck.
[star] Boost: Shuffle the trap discard pile and the top 2 cards of the encounter deck into the trap deck.

name: Nervous Jitters
text: Attach to your identity. Forced Interrupt: When you choose the "Avoid" effect or the "Disarm" effect on a [[Trap!]] card, name an encounter card type, then discard the top card of the encounter deck. If the card discarded this way was not of the named type, take 4 indirect damage and discard this attachment.

flavor: "Your only path is through me. Let us begin."
name: Iron Monk
text: Patrol. Toughness. While Iron Monk is engaged with you, you cannot choose the "Avoid" effect on [[Trap!]] cards.

name: Hall of Punishment
text:
Forced Interrupt: When you choose the "Trip" effect on a [[Trap!]] card, discard the top 3 cards of your deck.
[star] Boost: Place 1 threat on the main scheme for each character you control.

flavor: Every step is a test of resilience.
name: Path of a Thousand Cuts
text:
Forced Interrupt: When you choose the "Avoid" effect or the "Trip" effect on a [[Trap!]] card, take 2 indirect damage.
[star] Boost: Deal 1 damage to each character you control.

name: Blinding Powder
text: When Revealed: Choose: • Avoid — Discard a [[Thwart]] event from your hand. • Disarm — Discard 2 cards at random from your hand, then give a character you control a tough status card. • Trip — Deal 2 damage to your identity and confuse it.

name: Caltrops
text: When Revealed: Choose: • Avoid — Discard a [[Defense]] event from your hand. • Disarm — Discard 1 identity-specific card from your hand, then deal 2 damage to an enemy. • Trip — Deal 2 damage to your identity and stun it.

name: Krahllak
text: Steady. [star] Interrupt: When Krahllak attacks you, you may place 1 corruption counter on your Creeping Corruption. If you do, Krahllak gets –3 ATK for this attack.

name: Mark of the Wicked
text: When Revealed: You may attach this card to your identity. If you do not, take 4 damage, stun your identity, remove 1 corruption counter from your Creeping Corruption, and discard this card. [star] Forced Response: After attached hero makes a basic attack, place 1 corruption counter on your Creeping Corruption.

name: Pull of Power
text: When Revealed: You may attach this card to your identity. If you do not, take 4 damage, confuse your identity, remove 1 corruption counter from your Creeping Corruption, and discard this card. [star] Forced Response: After attached hero makes a basic thwart, place 1 corruption counter on your Creeping Corruption.

name: Hellbride
text: When Defeated: The defeating player places 2 corruption counters on their Creeping Corruption, then heals 6 damage from their identity. Hero Action: If Hellbride has 2 or fewer remaining hit points, exhaust your hero → discard Hellbride. Remove 1 corruption counter from your Creeping Corruption.

name: Snakeroot Elders
text: While there is at least 1 corruption counter here, Snakeroot Elders gains guard and patrol. When Revealed: You may place 1 corruption counter on your Creeping Corruption. If you do not, place 1 corruption counter here.

flavor: Krahllak's dark magic can tap into a person's deepest fears.
name: Veil of Nightmares
text: Hero Action: Place 1 corruption counter on your Creeping Corruption → remove 5 threat from this scheme.

name: Submit or Suffer
text:
When Revealed: Choose: Either place 1 corruption counter on your Creeping Corruption, or remove 1 corruption counter from your Creeping Corruption and Krahllak attacks you.
[star] Boost: Choose: Either place 1 corruption counter on your Creeping Corruption, or stun your identity.
